collateral: _decode_base32: my own L3 fix ran the alphabet check AFTER .upper(), so it structurally could not catch the fold it was written to catch. Found by the regression test, not by any gate. Re-fixed to validate before folding; mutation_probe confirms the test kills a revert to the broken form.
_decode_base32: same fix now strips all whitespace, not only U+0020 - the docstring promised tolerance a tab or nbsp did not get.

UpdateDialog release-notes sanitiser: my L24 fix spelled the bidi range with LITERAL U+202A/U+202E characters, putting real bidi overrides into rolodex.py -- the Trojan Source hazard, introduced by the guard against it. bandit B613 caught it on the check-code re-run (it was not present before this session). str.isprintable() is already False for every Cf format character, so the range was redundant as well as harmful; removed.
surfaced: security-standards.md §2 and the project CLAUDE.md both prescribed the pre-1.3.1 os.open write. Corrected, but security-standards.md is a STANDARD - a conformer would now do something different, so under CLAUDE.md rule 14 that edit owes a review-contract gate which has NOT been run.
